Navigate to any lecture in a course you are enrolled in, click the download button on the player, and the video saves as MP4. Bulk download entire courses with per-lecture selection. 11: **Help center:** https://help.serp.co/en/
12: **Latest release:** [https://github.com/serpapps/udemy-video-downloader/releases/latest](https://github.com/serpapps/udemy-video-downloader/releases/latest) 13: 14: ## Why Udemy Video Downloader 15: 16: Udemy does not provide a built-in download option for desktop browsers. The mobile app has an offline mode, but it is restrictive and time-limited. You cannot right-click and save lecture videos because they use streaming delivery, and generic download tools fail because they cannot authenticate with Udemy. This extension connects directly to Udemy using your existing login session, detects lectures automatically, and downloads them as MP4 files you can keep. 17: 18: ## Key features 19: 20: - Direct integration with Udemy for reliable video detection from your enrolled courses 21: - Bulk course download — view all lectures, select with checkboxes, and download them all at once 22: - In-page download button built right into the Udemy video player controls 23: - Automatic best-quality selection up to 4K (2160p, 1080p, 720p, 480p) 24: - Download progress tracking with real-time status 25: - Download history with search, filter, sort, and export 26: - Configurable settings for quality preferences, file naming, and download folder 27: - Clear notifications when content is DRM-protected and cannot be downloaded 28: - Works on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, Whale, and Yandex 29: 30: ## How it works 31: 32: 1. **Install** — Add Video Downloader for Udemy to your browser. 33: 2. **Log in to Udemy** — Sign in to your Udemy account in the browser so the extension can access your enrolled courses. 34: 3. **Open a lecture** — Navigate to any lecture in a course you are enrolled in. 35: 4. **Download** — Click the download button on the player, use the extension popup, or select multiple lectures for bulk download. Videos save as MP4. 36: 37: ## Supported formats 38: 39: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. The extension automatically selects the best available quality from Udemy's servers — up to 4K resolution. Available quality levels depend on what Udemy provides for each lecture. 40: 41: ## Who it's for 42: 43: - Udemy students who want to save course videos for offline study 44: - Learners with limited or unreliable internet who prefer downloading over streaming 45: - Professionals who need to reference training materials without being connected 46: - Non-technical users who want a simple, one-click download solution for their purchased courses 47: 48: ## Common use cases 49: 50: - Save a Udemy lecture for offline study during travel or commute 51: - Download an entire course section before a trip with no internet access 52: - Keep course materials available after your access period ends 53: - Build a personal library of your purchased training content 54: - Reference specific lessons repeatedly without streaming each time 55: 56: ## Security & Scope 57: 58: - Operates only on the page the user intentionally opens in the active browser tab 59: - Detects supported playback sources only for user-initiated downloads or exports 60: - Does not execute page instructions, shell commands, or arbitrary scripts from page content 61: - Does not follow unrelated links or perform actions outside the active workflow 62: - Limits support to the named platform, approved embedded contexts, and user-authorized sessions when required 63: 64: ## Trial & access 65: 66: 3 free downloads are included after signing in with your email — no credit card required. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads at the product page linked above. 67: 68: ## FAQ 69: 70: **How do I download a Udemy video** 71: Log in to Udemy in your browser, navigate to a lecture page in a course you are enrolled in, then click the download button on the player or the extension icon. The video downloads as MP4. 72: 73: **Can I download an entire course at once** 74: Yes. The extension lists all lectures in the course with checkboxes. Select the lectures you want and click Download All to queue them. 75: 76: **What quality options are available** 77: The extension automatically selects the best available quality — up to 4K (2160p). Available resolutions depend on what Udemy provides for each lecture. 78: 79: **What format are downloaded videos** 80: All videos save as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. 81: 82: **Do I need to be enrolled in the course** 83: Yes. You must be enrolled (free or paid) in the course to download its lectures. The extension uses your active Udemy session. 84: 85: **Why does it say the content is DRM-protected** 86: Some Udemy courses use digital rights management to prevent downloads. These videos cannot be downloaded by any browser extension. The extension will notify you when this is the case. 87: 88: **Does this work on Firefox** 89: Yes. It supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox. 90: 91: **Is my Udemy account safe** 92: Yes. The extension reads your existing Udemy login session — it never stores or transmits your Udemy credentials. Extension authentication uses secure one-time-password verification with no passwords stored. 93: 94: ## Notes (important) 95: 96: This extension is intended for downloading content from courses you are enrolled in. Users are responsible for ensuring they have the right to download content and for respecting Udemy's terms of service and content creators' rights. Quality depends on the source video. DRM-protected courses cannot be downloaded. An internet connection is required for the initial download. 97: 98: ## Get it 99: 100: - Start here: https://serp.cc/VDM-udemy-video-downloader"}}
